title: Experts, Errors, and Context: A Large-Scale Study of Human Evaluation for Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing crowd-worker quality assessments of machine translation outputs against professional translator evaluations using the Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) framework to demonstrate crowd-workers' systemic preference for literal, easy-to-rate translations over correct paraphrases.

Evaluating machine translation systems using paraphrased human reference translations alongside standard references to demonstrate how standard reference-based evaluation methodologies unfairly penalize correct translations that diverge structurally or lexically from the original reference.
